title: Huge Scene with Geolocated Models
description: An archipelago of 54 rocky islands spread across a 56 km expanse of ocean, geo-located at real-world UTM Zone 32N coordinates (~267 km easting, 6.55 million metres northing — off the Norwegian coast, ~50 km west of Stavanger). Three buildings inhabit the scene: a Duplex on the central island, an IfcOpenHouse4 on the far NW island, and a Ferry afloat ~12 km southeast.
